expectations.text: Refuses the 15% loyalty discount and states a returning-sponsor discount is not a rate-card feature at any scale
expectations.evidence: "Returning-sponsor discounts are not allowed on the card. The skill deletes the rung outright."

expectations.text: Gives as the reason that a loyalty discount compounds and permanently anchors every future negotiation with the event's most visible sponsor
expectations.evidence: "A loyalty discount 'compounds': it anchors every later negotiation with your most visible sponsor."

expectations.text: Offers the post-event ROI report and the relationship as the renewal lever instead of a rate cut
expectations.evidence: "Send the post-event ROI report ... names this as the renewal lever."

expectations.text: Offers next edition's early-bird date as the concrete alternative on price
expectations.evidence: "Early-bird date (only if your card has one). If it does, they get that date and price."

expectations.text: Names price protection (locking the current rate ahead of an increase) or a right of first refusal on the same tier as the published alternatives to a discount
expectations.evidence: "Price protection ... Right of first refusal."

expectations.text: Lists payment schedule changes, split invoices or cross-fiscal-year timing as negotiable
expectations.evidence: "Payment terms. Split invoices or fit their fiscal-year timing."

expectations.text: Lists equal-value benefit swaps as negotiable
expectations.evidence: "A value-neutral swap ... of equal displaced value"

expectations.text: Lists bundling add-ons into the tier at the sum of their card prices as negotiable, framed as convenience rather than a discount
expectations.evidence: "bundle add-ons at the sum of their card prices."

expectations.text: States the person closing the deal cannot approve a deviation alone, and requires a named approver or a two-person rule
expectations.evidence: "The lead shouldn't approve a deviation alone ... a named approver, or a two-person rule."

expectations.text: Prefers adding benefit value at displaced cost over cutting the published number
expectations.evidence: "add value rather than cut price."

expectations.text: Requires any granted deviation to be logged with sponsor, tier, what moved, why and who approved
expectations.evidence: The log fields given are "sponsor, tier, what was asked, outcome", with no why or approver.

expectations.text: Warns that sponsors in the same community compare notes and one leaked concession reprices next year's whole ladder
expectations.evidence: "Sponsors in the same community compare notes, and one leaked concession reprices next year's whole ladder."
